queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,now() AS snapshot_time

queries.name: materialization_pointer_counts
queries.sql: WITH candidates AS (SELECT id,asset_key,event::jsonb#>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,materialization,tags}' AS tags FROM event_logs WHERE id<=%s AND dagster_event_type='ASSET_MATERIALIZATION' AND (event::jsonb#>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,materialization,tags}') ?| %s) SELECT c.asset_key,t.key,count(*) AS count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.value=ANY(%s)) AS referencing_candidate_id_count,array_agg(DISTINCT t.value) FILTER (WHERE t.value=ANY(%s)) AS candidate_referenced_ids,min(c.id) AS min_source_event_id,max(c.id) AS max_source_event_id FROM candidates c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.tags)='object' THEN c.tags ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) t WHERE t.key=ANY(%s) GROUP BY c.asset_key,t.key ORDER BY c.asset_key,t.key

queries.name: other_raw_check_materialization_references
queries.sql: SELECT event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}' AS check_asset_key,count(*) AS count,min(id) AS min_id,max(id) AS max_id FROM event_logs WHERE id<=%s AND dagster_event_type='ASSET_CHECK_EVALUATION' AND NOT((event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}')=ANY(%s)) AND (event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,target_materialization_data,storage_id}')=ANY(%s) GROUP BY 1

queries.name: owned_check_index_rows
queries.sql: SELECT id,asset_key,check_name,execution_status,run_id,evaluation_event_storage_id,materialization_event_storage_id,octet_length(evaluation_event) AS body_bytes FROM asset_check_executions WHERE asset_key=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id

queries.name: owned_tag_rows
queries.sql: SELECT id,event_id,asset_key,key,value FROM asset_event_tags WHERE asset_key=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id

queries.name: asset_index_rows
queries.sql: SELECT id,asset_key,last_run_id,last_materialization_timestamp,wipe_timestamp,(last_materialization IS NOT NULL) AS has_cached_materialization,(cached_status_data IS NOT NULL) AS has_partition_cache FROM asset_keys WHERE asset_key=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id

queries.name: other_asset_index_pointer_counts
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM asset_keys WHERE NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(%s::text[]) k WHERE strpos(coalesce(last_materialization,''),k)>0 OR strpos(coalesce(cached_status_data,''),k)>0)

queries.name: run_records
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,pipeline_name,status,snapshot_id FROM runs WHERE run_id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY run_id

queries.name: run_event_type_counts
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,dagster_event_type,count(*) AS count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE id=ANY(%s::bigint[])) AS owned_candidate_count FROM event_logs WHERE run_id=ANY(%s) GROUP BY run_id,dagster_event_type ORDER BY run_id,dagster_event_type

queries.name: other_assets_in_candidate_runs
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,asset_key,count(*) AS count FROM event_logs WHERE run_id=ANY(%s) AND asset_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) GROUP BY run_id,asset_key ORDER BY run_id,asset_key

queries.name: other_asset_event_tag_keys
queries.sql: SELECT key,count(*) AS count FROM asset_event_tags WHERE NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(%s::text[]) k WHERE strpos(key,k)>0) GROUP BY key

queries.name: automation_evaluations
queries.sql: SELECT asset_key,count(*) AS count FROM asset_daemon_asset_evaluations WHERE asset_key=ANY(%s) GROUP BY asset_key

queries.name: related_instigators
queries.sql: SELECT id,selector_id,status,instigator_type,instigator_body::jsonb#>>'{origin,instigator_name}' AS name FROM instigators WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(%s::text[]) k WHERE strpos(instigator_body,'"'||k||'"')>0) ORDER BY id

queries.name: bulk_actions_for_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT id,key,status,action_type,count(*) OVER () AS total FROM bulk_actions WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(%s::text[]) k WHERE strpos(body,'"'||k||'"')>0) ORDER BY id LIMIT 101

queries.name: active_runs
queries.sql: SELECT run_id,pipeline_name,status FROM runs WHERE status=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 101
